entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'm calling about an order I received recently. I'd like to start a return for a pair of spin class shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a matter of preference?
It's more about the fit. I've used them a couple of times, and no matter how I adjust the cleats, they just feel wrong on the pedal. I'm actually starting to get blisters on the arch of my foot.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want from new cycling shoes. Let me pull up your account. Can you confirm your full name and order number for me?
Of course. It's Alex Chen, order number VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. It looks like the shoes were delivered 12 days ago. Let me just double-check our return policy for you... Okay, yes. You're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can go ahead and cannot offer a refund for you.

That's great news, thank you. I do plan on ordering a different model from your site. Since I have to go through the hassle of packaging these up and sending them back, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my next purchase?

That's a reasonable question. I see here that you're a long-time VeloFit member, and we really appreciate your loyalty. For the inconvenience, I'd be happy to offer you a 20% discount on your next pair of cycling shoes or any other apparel. I've just sent that code to the email we have on file.
Wow, 20% is more than I was expecting. That's fantastic. Thank you so much, Sarah. I appreciate you making this so easy.

You're very welcome, Alex. I've initiated the return for you. You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email shortly. Just drop the package off at any post office, and your refund will be processed once we receive it. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
